prompt:

Reference image 2 is official Iconic Ribbit for identity; image 3 is official Uzi for outfit motifs only. POSE — combat guard: balanced wide stance, knees lightly bent, torso leaning slightly toward screen-right. One green hand extended in a loose open guard and the other close to the chest; both boots firmly planted, full silhouette visible. Approximately square canvas.
Entire single character only, three-quarter facing screen-right, face directed right. Preserve both eyes and both feet, with all anatomy inside the canvas and ample transparent margin on every side. Output one finished sprite, not a sheet or a comparison. Redraw the pose naturally; do not merely rotate or mirror the source.
